Class JSONUtils.JSONRecord

public class JSONUtils.JSONRecord

Wrapper class for parsing and manipulating JSON data with support for nested paths and array notation. Provides type-safe methods for extracting values as various data types (String, Integer, Decimal, Date, etc.) and supports nested object traversal using path notation (e.g., "customer/address/city").

private JSONUtils.JSONRecord cloneJSONRecord()

Creates a shallow clone of this JSONRecord.

Returns:

public Boolean containsField(String tokenPath)

Checks if the JSON record contains a field specified by the token path.

Parameters:
    tokenPath – Path to the token in the JSON object, which can be a simple field name or a path with nested objects (e.g., "object/field"). Also supports array notation (e.g., "object[0]/field").

Returns:
    True if the field exists, false otherwise.

public Object get(String tokenPath)

Returns the value of the given token path in the JSON object.

Parameters:
    tokenPath – Path to the token in the JSON object, which can be a simple field name or a path with nested objects (e.g., "object/field"). Also supports array notation (e.g., "object[0]/field").

Returns:
    The value of the token, or null if the token is not found or the path is invalid.

public Boolean getAsBoolean(String token)

Returns the value of the given token as a Boolean. Converts string representations like 'true', 'yes', '1' to true.

Parameters:
    token – Path to the token in the JSON object.

Returns:
    True if the token value represents a truthy value, false otherwise.

public JSONUtils.JSONRecord getAsRecord(String tokenPath)

Returns the value of the given token path as a nested JSONRecord. Supports traversal through nested objects using path notation (e.g., "customer/address").

Parameters:
    tokenPath – Path to the token in the JSON object, which can be a simple field name or a nested path.

Returns:
    JSONRecord wrapping the nested object, or null if the token is not found or is not an object.

private JSONUtils.JSONRecord getAsRecord(
  String tokenPath,
  Boolean logException
)

Returns the value of the given token path as a nested JSONRecord. Supports traversal through nested objects using path notation (e.g., "customer/address"). Additional parameter to control exception logging.

Parameters:
    tokenPath – Path to the token in the JSON object, which can be a simple field name or a nested path.
    logException – Whether to log exceptions encountered during parsing.

Returns:
    JSONRecord wrapping the nested object, or null if the token is not found or is not an object.

public JSONUtils.JSONRecord put(
  String fieldName,
  Object value
)

Adds or updates a field in the JSON record with support for nested path notation. Creates nested objects automatically when using path notation (e.g., "customer/address/city").

Parameters:
    fieldName – Simple field name or nested path using '/' as separator.
    value – The value to set for the field.

Returns:
    This JSONRecord instance for method chaining.

Since:
    04/19/2021

private JSONUtils.JSONRecord put(
  String fieldName,
  Object value,
  Map<String, Object> jsonRecord
)

Internal recursive method to add or update a field with nested path support. Navigates through the JSON structure and creates intermediate objects as needed.

Parameters:
    fieldName – Field name or remaining path to process.
    value – The value to set for the field.
    jsonRecord – The current level of the JSON map being processed.

Returns:
    This JSONRecord instance for method chaining.

private Map<String, Object> recursiveMap(
  String fieldName,
  Object value
)

Creates a nested map structure recursively based on the field path. Used internally by put() to build nested JSON objects from path notation.

Parameters:
    fieldName – Field name or remaining path to process.
    value – The value to set at the deepest level.

Returns:
    Map representing the nested structure.
